lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

steps: Prepare a Collector project with at least 13 layers including a read-only simple Point layer whose initial visible is false, an editable field vector whose initial visible is false, a MultiPolygon feature with a real hole and a second polygon member, editable enabled only for field vectors, and supported qgis_vector_style and qgis_raster_style items between vectors
Add one server layer containing 15 MultiPolygon features and about 140000 positions, with one feature near 60000 positions and hundreds of polygon members
Reset all settings and import the Collector resource while interacting with the progress UI
From Add layer choose Load project, confirm the lisa catalog lists the same Collector projects as a radio list with dividers that scrolls when it is taller than the screen, select one and press Load
Verify every layer has a distinct local storage path and the large layer has exactly 15 local features
Verify the ordinary MultiPolygon retains both members and exactly one hole
Enable the read-only Point layer only in the local layer drawer without changing server config or running sync
Verify Point features render immediately while identify returns the same objects
Verify style tiles load with the project account and mixed order matches Collector
Verify My Tracks is the first and OpenStreetMap Standard aka Mapnik is the last layer-list row
Start object creation and inspect offered layers, then select the hidden editable vector and add an object
Reopen and run composition sync, then repeat import with two different layers sharing a display name
value.expected: Project metadata and isolated workspace are created; concurrent fills use distinct storage and fail without retaining incomplete layers. The 15-feature large geometry layer finishes while the application stays responsive and progress never presents polygon members or positions as thousands of features. The ordinary MultiPolygon keeps both polygon members and its real hole. Enabling a layer omitted from the initial live style rebuilds its source/layer from local data without server config update, sync or app restart. Layers are keyed by remote id, supported styles appear as authenticated read-only raster layers in the same order as vectors, My Tracks stays on top, default OSM stays at internal index zero without visibility reset, and only Collector vectors with editable plus outbound sync are offered for object creation regardless of visibility; selecting a hidden eligible vector makes it visibly persist before editing. Load project shows a radio list with dividers, scrolls when it is taller than the screen, and starts import only after Load.
